title: docsrs-cli dry-run success envelope fragment
description: When global --dry-run is set on a network command, success envelopes include dry_run=true and data with planned_url plus planned_params. planned_params always use crate_name (never crate).

planned_params.description: Command-specific planned fields; crate fields use crate_name. search-in-crate planned limit is clamped to 1000 even if --limit is higher. Keys vary by command, so additionalProperties remains true only on this bag.
